suggest.laravel-zero/foundation: Required only by PlaylogiqUtils\Jobs\BaseJob and its subclasses, for Illuminate\Foundation\Bus\Dispatchable. A Laravel application already has illuminate/foundation through laravel/framework and needs nothing extra. It is deliberately NOT a hard requirement: in Lumen, that mirror's helpers.php is autoloaded before Lumen's own, so Laravel's storage_path() and response() win and then fail on container bindings Lumen never makes (path.storage, the ResponseFactory contract) — which breaks the host application on every request. A Lumen app that wants the jobs must require it itself and bind those.
suggest.aws/aws-sdk-php: Required by PlaylogiqUtils\Integrity: the fleet check sends integrity:verify over SSM (FleetCommand) and the settings snapshot store assumes a role through STS (SnapshotCredentials); the tinker audit reads the Session Manager log from CloudWatch (SessionManagerLogs). Every Playlogiq application that runs the checks already has it.
suggest.laravel/tinker: Audited by PlaylogiqUtils\Integrity\Tinker: AuditedTinkerCommand replaces v2.9.0's handle(), diff it on every upgrade.
